Field.Label: MagicHome talks to Zengge / Magic Home WiFi LED controllers directly on your network. No cloud account and no credentials are involved.
Look for controllers when the plugin starts
Controllers take a DHCP lease, so their address can change. A device set to use discovery is re-found automatically; one pinned to a fixed IP is not.
Twenty is smooth and comfortably within what the controller accepts. Much above twenty-five and commands start being dropped, which shows as stutter.
